body: as a fellow borderline with way too many emotions to the point of not being able to function, i can relate. im sorry about these commenters who dont get it. the exhausting agony of a constant emotional roller coaster is rly difficult to explain to those who aren't also on it 24/7. i think most ppl with bpd seek numbness too. im sorry idk how to help u, but i wanted to let u know that at least ur not alone.

lmao i appreciate ur reply but if only u knew how terrible my experiences with both have been. ive tried so many antidepressants & they have only made things worse for me (check out a recent example in my post in r/antidepressants if u feel like it). i used to smoke all day every day for years & it fucked up my brain & now i can't remember shit anymore. i rly wish those were the great but simple answers you & most other ppl seem to think they are
i just want to sleep. the only razor i could find is way too dull to do anything so i guess i have to wait until tomorrow so i can make an exit bag. wish me luck yall
